meaning: measure word for volumes of a book, rolls and scrolls

senses.en: measure word for volumes of a book, rolls and scrolls

note: Also 一卷纸 (a roll of paper); 上卷/下卷 are the first/second volume.

examples.zh: 这本书有上下两卷。
examples.en: This book has two volumes, upper and lower.

examples.zh: 我想买一卷纸。
examples.en: I want to buy a roll of paper.

examples.zh: 你看到第几卷了？
examples.en: Which volume have you got to?

meaning: to not matter; to not mind, to be indifferent

senses.en: to not matter; to not mind, to be indifferent

note: 无所谓 alone is a common reply: "Whatever, I don't mind."

examples.zh: 吃什么都无所谓，你决定吧。
examples.en: I don't mind what we eat; you decide.

examples.zh: 他对钱无所谓，只要开心就行。
examples.en: He doesn't care about money, as long as he's happy.

examples.zh: 你怎么什么都无所谓？
examples.en: Why don't you care about anything?

note: 好姐妹 is often said between close female friends, not only blood sisters.

examples.zh: 我们是好姐妹，什么都说。
examples.en: We're close sisters; we tell each other everything.

examples.zh: 她们两个是姐妹，长得很像。
examples.en: The two of them are sisters and look very alike.

examples.zh: 周末我要和姐妹们一起看电影。
examples.en: This weekend I am seeing a film with my girls.

examples.zh: 这个人很神秘，没人知道他的工作。
examples.en: This man is mysterious; nobody knows what he does.

examples.zh: 她给了我一个神秘的礼物。
examples.en: She gave me a mystery gift.

examples.zh: 你为什么说话这么神秘？
examples.en: Why are you being so mysterious?

examples.zh: 我对政治不太感兴趣。
examples.en: I'm not very interested in politics.

examples.zh: 吃饭的时候，我们别谈政治。
examples.en: Let's not talk politics during dinner.

examples.zh: 他在大学学政治。
examples.en: He studies politics at university.

note: Used for size and for abstract things: 巨大的变化, 巨大的压力.

examples.zh: 这个城市这几年有了巨大的变化。
examples.en: This city has changed enormously in recent years.

examples.zh: 他承受着巨大的压力。
examples.en: He is under enormous pressure.

examples.zh: 桌子上放着一个巨大的西瓜。
examples.en: There is a huge watermelon on the table.

note: Parents also call a child or a partner 宝宝 as a pet name.

examples.zh: 你们家宝宝几个月了？
examples.en: How many months old is your baby?

examples.zh: 宝宝睡着了，小声一点。
examples.en: The baby has fallen asleep; keep your voice down.

examples.zh: 宝宝，别哭，妈妈来了。
examples.en: Don't cry, baby; Mommy is here.

meaning: to climb, to go up (a mountain, stairs)

senses.en: to climb, to go up (a mountain, stairs)

note: 登山 means mountain climbing; 登上 means to reach the top of.

examples.zh: 我们周末去登山吧。
examples.en: Let's go climbing this weekend.

examples.zh: 他登上了最高的山，很开心。
examples.en: He climbed the highest mountain and was very happy.

examples.zh: 你登过长城吗？
examples.en: Have you ever climbed the Great Wall?

note: 很刺激 means thrilling, exciting, as in a film or a ride.

examples.zh: 别刺激他了，他心情不好。
examples.en: Stop provoking him; he's in a bad mood.

examples.zh: 这部电影太刺激了，我不敢看。
examples.en: This film is so intense that I don't dare watch.

examples.zh: 太辣的东西会刺激肚子。
examples.en: Very spicy food can irritate your stomach.

note: Describes how someone does something: 独自旅行, 独自生活.

examples.zh: 她独自一个人去中国旅游。
examples.en: She traveled to China all by herself.

examples.zh: 他独自在家，有点儿害怕。
examples.en: He's home alone and a bit scared.

examples.zh: 晚上别独自出门，不安全。
examples.en: Don't go out alone at night; it isn't safe.

meaning: child, children (a general or official term)

senses.en: child, children (a general or official term)

note: More formal than 孩子; seen on signs and tickets: 儿童票.

examples.zh: 六岁以下的儿童可以免费。
examples.en: Children under six get in free.

examples.zh: 这本书是给儿童看的。
examples.en: This book is for children.

examples.zh: 带儿童的人请先上车。
examples.en: Those with children, please board first.

note: Needs an object or 被: 打败对手, 被打败.

examples.zh: 我们队打败了他们，赢了比赛。
examples.en: Our team beat them and won the match.

examples.zh: 他想打败所有的对手。
examples.en: He wants to defeat all his rivals.

examples.zh: 这次我们被对方打败了。
examples.en: This time we were beaten by the other side.

examples.zh: 春节吃饺子是中国的传统。
examples.en: Eating dumplings at Spring Festival is a Chinese tradition.

examples.zh: 我喜欢传统的做法。
examples.en: I like the traditional way of doing it.

examples.zh: 中医是中国的传统医学。
examples.en: Chinese medicine is China's traditional medicine.

meaning: to keep (a rule, a promise); to guard, to keep watch

senses.en: to keep (a rule, a promise); to guard, to keep watch

note: Common: 守规则, 守时, 守着 (stay by and watch).

examples.zh: 请大家守规则，排队上车。
examples.en: Everyone please follow the rules and queue to board.

examples.zh: 他一晚上都在医院守着孩子。
examples.en: He stayed by his child's side at the hospital all night.

examples.zh: 你答应过的事，要守约。
examples.en: You must keep what you promised.

meaning: to be confident in oneself; (adj.) confident

senses.en: to be confident in oneself; (adj.) confident

note: Used both as a verb (自信能做好) and as an adjective (很自信).

examples.zh: 我自信能做好这件事。
examples.en: I'm confident I can do this well.

examples.zh: 他很自信，说话很大声。
examples.en: He is very confident and speaks loudly.

examples.zh: 面试的时候要自信一点儿。
examples.en: Be a bit more confident at the interview.

meaning: to be startled, to be surprised

senses.en: to be startled, to be surprised

note: Verb-object word, but usually works like an adjective: 很吃惊.

examples.zh: 听到这个消息，我很吃惊。
examples.en: I was shocked to hear this news.

examples.zh: 他说他不会游泳，大家都吃惊了。
examples.en: He said he can't swim and everyone was surprised.

examples.zh: 你不用这么吃惊，我早就知道了。
examples.en: No need to be so surprised; I knew long ago.

note: 盖被子 (cover with a quilt), 盖房子 (build a house), 盖章 (stamp).

examples.zh: 晚上冷，记得盖好被子。
examples.en: It's cold at night; remember to cover yourself well.

examples.zh: 他把杯子盖上了。
examples.en: He put the lid on the cup.

examples.zh: 老家的房子是去年盖的。
examples.en: The house back home was built last year.

note: Also 幢; the building's name often ends in 大楼: 办公大楼.

examples.zh: 我的办公室在那座大楼的十楼。
examples.en: My office is on the tenth floor of that building.

examples.zh: 对面有一座新大楼。
examples.en: There is a new building across the street.

examples.zh: 请问，这座大楼里有银行吗？
examples.en: Excuse me, is there a bank in this building?

note: Also an adjective: 移动电话 (mobile phone), and China Mobile is 中国移动.

examples.zh: 请把车移动一下，我要出去。
examples.en: Please move your car; I need to get out.

examples.zh: 这张桌子太重，我一个人移动不了。
examples.en: This table is too heavy for me to move alone.

examples.zh: 请不要移动病人。
examples.en: Please do not move the patient.

note: 牙 is the everyday word: 刷牙, 牙疼, 看牙医.

examples.zh: 我的牙很疼，想去看医生。
examples.en: My tooth hurts a lot; I want to see a doctor.

examples.zh: 你每天刷牙几次？
examples.en: How many times a day do you brush your teeth?

examples.zh: 他掉了一个牙。
examples.en: He lost a tooth.
